fusions.name: Called Shot
fusions.desc: A single aimed shot that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Fan Fire
fusions.desc: Empties 5 shots in a fan, spread apart, each of which deals 6 damage and knocks its target back 2 tiles, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Sentry Piece
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to set a loaded piece on a rest beside you for 12 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it fires on an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage.

fusions.name: Double Tap
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
